correctness.rationale: The trace form is alternating, and for x≠0 the expression B(x,xz)=Tr(x^9(z+z^8)) is not identically zero since z+z^8 ranges over F and x^9∈F*; the norm-one torus preserves it. I independently checked the primitive field model and generated all isotropic spaces by orthogonal one-vector extensions. For order-nine powers the degree ord_9(2)=6 rules out proper invariant subspaces. For ω of order three, invariant subspaces are F4-linear, so only the F4-lines can occur in building ranks 1–3. The norm x^9 is constant on each F4-line apart from zero, with three lines per nonzero F8 norm. B(x,ωx)=Tr(x^9); there are three nonzero trace-zero norm values, yielding exactly nine isolated fixed vertices and three branched orbits. Rank preservation excludes inversions and any positive-dimensional fixed cells. Independent flag-orbit enumeration gives original ranks (63,315,135), 2835 edges and 2835 chambers, and orbit counts (59,315,315). The edge and chamber counts also follow from three points on each line, three Lagrangians on each line, and seven points on each Lagrangian. Solomon–Tits gives simple connectivity; Armstrong quotients by precisely the subgroup C3 generated by point stabilizers. Therefore π1=H1=C3 and the Euler characteristic is 59. The top integral cellular kernel is free of rank 58; connectedness, dimension two and the universal coefficient theorem give the other stated homology and cohomology groups.
residual_risks: The independent finite replay checks the explicit field, vertices, flags and orbit counts, not the frozen modular ranks; the integral and fundamental-group conclusions use the mathematical proof, not modular rank inference. The result concerns the ordinary geometric quotient, not a Borel construction or a full homotopy-type classification.

value.rationale: A canonical norm-one cyclic symmetry in a small rank-three symplectic building supplies a concrete ordinary quotient in which isolated stabilizers reduce, but do not kill, the fundamental group. The exact fixed-line count and resulting torsion and free top rank give a usable model for nonfree building quotients, not merely an application of the free-action Euler formula.
residual_risks: This is one natural action; no general classification, cup-product calculation or complete quotient homotopy type is implied.
